verses.1: And when Jesus was born in Bethlehem, in the days of King Herodes, magicians from the east came to Jerusalem.
verses.2: They said, “Who is the chosen king of the Jews? We want to see his star in the east, so that we can come and worship him.”
verses.3: And when King Herodes heard this, he became furious. All of Jerusalem also became in turmoil with him.
verses.4: And as he brought together all the high priests and officials of the people, he waited for the birth of the Christ.
verses.5: And they said to him, “In Bethlem of Judah.” This is indeed what it is written by the prophet.
verses.6: And you also, Bethlem, land of Judah, do not become insignificant among the rulers of Judah. For it is from you that a ruler will come, who will govern my people, Israel.
verses.7: Then Herodes, calling the magicians together, asked them about the time period during which that star appeared.
verses.8: And when you had sent them to Bethlehem, he said, “Go and carefully examine the baby. If you find anything, then tell me, so that I can come and worship him.”
verses.9: When they heard about the king’s arrival, they rushed forward. And indeed, the angel they saw in the east came to them. When he arrived, he stood above where the child was.
verses.10: Seeing the star, they were filled with great joy.
verses.11: And when they entered the house, they saw the child with Maria, his mother. They bowed down to him, and after opening their treasures, they gave him gifts: gold, silver, and spices.
verses.12: And after spending money, they refused to return to Herodes by another route. Instead, they went back to their own land.
verses.13: And while they were still there, an angel of the Lord appeared to them one morning, during Joshua’s time. He said, “Arise, and take the child and his mother, and go into Egypt. There, wait until I tell you. For Herod will seek to kill the child.”
verses.14: But the warrior took the child and his mother at night, and he rushed off to Egypt.
verses.15: And there he remained until the end of his life. This was so that he could pay off what had been owed by his master, as the prophet had said. From Egypt, I called my son back.
verses.16: Then Herodotus saw that he had been tricked by the magicians. He became very angry. So he sent all the children living in Babylon and all those who lived in his own land away from there, according to the time he had agreed upon with the magicians.
verses.17: Then, the promise made by the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled.
verses.18: A loud noise was heard in Rama; there was also a lot of crying and screaming. Rahil cried for her children, and she didn’t want to be called away from them.
verses.19: After Herod’s death, it seems that an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in Egypt.
verses.20: He went and took the child and his mother away to Israel. They died, for those who sought the child’s soul were dead.
verses.21: And the exuberant man took the child and his mother, and went into the land of Israel.
verses.22: When he heard that Archelaus was ruling Judea instead of his father Herodes, he feared going there. But after being paid money, he finally decided to go to the regions of Galilee.
verses.23: And he went and entered a city called Nazareth, so that he could fulfill what was prophesied by the prophets: that it would be called Nazareth.
